A market order the book cannot fill within 25 % (ruling 141) is refused 422 `trade.msgMarketSlippage` with `estimate`: `average` and `bound` (prices), `reachPct` and `boundPct` (percent from the best price) and `short` (the book shown is smaller than the size), decimal strings; sent again with that key in `overrides`, it goes at that bound; a trading key's order is sent with no refusal, as with every warning (RULINGS 75): at 25 % at most, or at that bound when the key names it in `overrides`, and its limits measure it where it is sent. x-gcx-tool.name: place_order
x-gcx-tool.description: Places an order within this key's limits. `body` is the order command (every number a decimal string) with a `requestId`: new for each new order, the same when retrying after no answer. A refusal is an error with the reason; nothing was placed and the same requestId may be sent again after a change. A Close or a reduce-only order (on spot a sell) counts nothing against the limits for what this key's own orders hold; the rest counts as an order that adds risk. A take-profit and stop-loss that does not say `reduceOnly` is reduce-only. The order is sent past the form's warnings: `preview_order` names them first.

body.description: The request's JSON, as the operation's request body.

order-command.title: Order command
order-command.description: What the panel and the agent surface send to place an order (POST /api/v1/orders). Every number is a decimal string, never a JSON number. One variant per order type; a field of another type is refused. The runtime dedups on requestId and re-validates with its own tick, balances, position and leverage. Mirrors src/domain/orders/command.ts (OrderCommand). See decisions 0004 §1 and 0007 part 3 decision 4, and docs/reference/orders/validation.md.

sizeUnit.description: base: the base asset; quote: the quote asset (on perps the notional, never the margin). A quote size is converted to base by the engine and floored to the size step; on spot a market buy's at the ask plus the 1 % entry cap, its limit at the exchange, so it never costs more than the amount.

reduceOnly.description: Only reduce the position. On a perpetual an order whose side and size close the position exactly, as gcx reads it when the order arrives, is sent reduce-only without it too, and gets no minimum-order-value warning (since 2026-10-05). x-gcx-tool.name: modify_order
x-gcx-tool.description: Changes an order this key placed. `body` is `{requestId, changes}` with only the fields that change (`size`, `price`, `triggerPrice`, `triggerTimeout`, `distance`, `trailStart`, decimal strings; `postOnly`, `reduceOnly`, `improveOnly`, booleans), or `{requestId, field, price}` to move its price or trigger. A refusal is an error with the reason; nothing changed. The changed order is judged by this key's limits as a new one would be, and counts against its 24 hours at its new value.

id.description: The order's id, percent-encoded as one segment (a take-profit leg `x1/tp1` is `x1%2Ftp1`).

body.description: The request's JSON, as the operation's request body.

runtime-api.modify.description: POST /api/v1/orders/{id}/modify (decision 0004 d10; release plan A65, A67): change an open order. Either a level dragged on the chart and confirmed (decision 0005, item 9), `field` and `price`, or the fields the modify form changes, `changes` (added in A65). What each order may change is goodcryptoX's caps table (docs/reference/orders/primitives.md, Modify); every price, size and duration is a decimal string.

size.description: The order's whole size in the base asset, what filled included.

price.description: A limit's price, a stop-limit's limit price.

distance.description: A trailing stop's distance, in the order's unit (percent or quote).

exits.description: Decision 0004 amendment 2 v4.3 d7 (added 2026-10-18): one Save of the order's Modify form that changes the order and its take-profit and stop-loss is one request. `bracket` is the whole TP/SL block after the Save (exits-command.schema.json, edit), null when both are switched off; `overrides` the exits' warnings sent anyway. The runtime judges the change, then the exits against the order as changed, and journals both in one step, or refuses the request and changes nothing. A person's only: a trading key's request carrying it is refused (key.order). Absent: the change alone, as before; an earlier runtime refuses a body with it.

order-command.bracket.description: Take-profit targets and one stop-loss attached to the order, placed on its fills. Every combination is valid here, including a limit take-profit with a stop-loss, by hand or from the DCA bot, on perps and on spot (ruling 381 b); on spot gcx's own stop-loss cancels the resting take-profit first and sells once the exchange confirmed the cancel (ruling 296 c).

reduceOnly.description: The take-profit and stop-loss only reduce the position (perpetuals). Default true: absent, the take-profit and stop-loss are reduce-only, whatever Settings › Trading says (MH 520); a received value is honoured. Spot has no reduce-only.

timeInForce.description: Added 2026-10-05 (MH, audit list 24): the take-profit and stop-loss's own time in force, one for both, counted from the order's full fill (on a position, from when they are set); at its end every one still open is cancelled, with one notice. Absent with no cancelAt: one year (31536000000 ms) for new API/MCP submissions, independent of panel Settings (MH481). Old journal rows retain no expiry. An older build ignores it.

cancelAt.description: C79 B2/B4: cancel both TP/SL legs at this UTC moment, not with timeInForce. MH480, MH484 (500 (1)): not before the entry's expiry and (a market or gc-market entry expires at its send; on a position or an order already filled, counted from acceptance): before the entry's expiry is HTTP 400, equality accepted; more than one year after it is the overridable warning trade.bracket.msgExpiryTooLong (HTTP 422 until named in overrides). A late full fill retains this end; the old journal failure path expires elapsed exits without placing. Older readers ignore this field and do not support absolute TP/SL expiry.

value.description: Percent, quote distance or price, per mode.

share.description: Percent of the parent's filled size this target closes.

minProfit.description: Percent; activation waits until this profit (improve-only).

mode.description: loss: value is the expected loss in quote.

follow.description: Follow TPs: move to break-even at the first target, or to the previous target at each. Off when absent.

order-command.millis.description: A duration in milliseconds, as a string.

order-command.exitTimeInForce.description: MH484: above zero and at most one year, 31536000000 milliseconds; over the limit is HTTP 400 with the house limit message, never silently cut.

order-command.instant.description: A moment, in milliseconds since the epoch (UTC), as a string.

exits-command.overrides.description: Keys of the warnings the caller sends anyway: the order form's overridable warnings and the two of a DCA bot on the coin (RULINGS 65). Errors cannot be overridden.

200.description: `{id}`; with `warning`, a sentence the bot was created despite (RULINGS 148 (b): a TA bot on spot a sell signal can arm, without the coin for a full sell ladder free). To a trading key: 422 `key.*` with the limit it broke (no limits yet, account, market, an order of the ladder over the largest order `key.botOrder`, the whole ladder over what is left of the 24 hours `key.bot24h`, the leverage `key.botLeverage`, or `key.botPosition` when it names none and the position it would take is above the limit); 503 "The position could not be read. Try again." when it names no leverage or margin mode and the account's position cannot be read (nothing is set or created); 403 `key.suspended` or `key.revoked` when a person stopped it. A key's bot counts its open cycle against the key's 24 hours, is counted again at each new cycle (over them it waits in repair `key-limit` and goes on by itself once they have room) and is paused while the key is suspended.

A refusal is an error with the reason; nothing was created. Each new cycle is counted against the 24 hours again: over them the bot waits, and goes on by itself once they have room.

dca-bot-create.title: DCA bot settings
dca-bot-create.description: The settings a live DCA bot runs on (decision 0016 §2, §7.2), as the reducer takes them: written by hand to mirror src/domain/dca/live.ts (DcaLiveConfig), kept equal by tests/dca/live-schema.test.ts. Each `default` is goodcryptoX's form default as ruled in 0016 §2 (what a hidden field takes); each range is the old form's. Every money, price and percentage value is a decimal string; counts and times are integers. The account, the instrument, margin and leverage, name and note join this with the create route (slice L2); the TA start's periods and signals came with the signal engine (decision 0017, slice T2). The domain refuses what a pattern cannot (validateLiveConfig): a trailing take-profit that can exit below the average, an amount of zero, the lower bound of each range.

investment.description: A3 d100: absent means quote. Quote is form metadata. Account is a percent of held account value: Approx. margin on perps (ladder margin plus the stop-loss reserve; without a stop, margin and fees plus the loss at the last averaging level), orders total on spot. Exact resolved sizing is journaled; replay never re-reads.

reinvest.description: A2 d70: grow each new cycle by all realized profit, fees and funding included; ignored with account investment

entryCondition.description: When a cycle's entry starts: at once and after each cooldown (manual), on a TA signal (ta; needs taPeriods and taSignals), on a TradingView webhook. POST /api/v1/bots refuses webhook with the named error `entry-condition-not-yet` until the Signal bot ships (release plan v4 §10). goodcryptoX's form defaulted to ta; the panel form opens on Signal too (T3), and this default stays manual: a create that omits the field must not wait on a signal nobody set.

entrySide.description: manual: buy or sell. ta: direct (the signal's side) or inverse. webhook: direct.

taPeriods.description: ta: the candle periods rated, the venue's own (Hyperliquid's fourteen); every one must agree for the bot to start (decision 0017 d8, d9). Required with ta, refused otherwise.

taSignals.description: ta: Detect signals. Buy starts at a rating above 0.1 (a score of 3 of 26), Strong Buy above 0.5 (14 of 26), Sell and Strong Sell the mirror; Buy includes Strong Buy. Required with ta, refused otherwise.

entryDistancePct.description: limit: this far from the market when the entry is made, 0 to 99; trailing: the bounce off the extreme, 0.1 to 99 (§2 row 7).

sizingMode.description: cost: amounts in the quote currency; size: in the base coin.

averaging.description: one: every level a stop-limit triggered at the previous level, one resting at a time (goodcryptoX); all: every level a resting limit at once.

postOnly.description: Averaging limits post-only; a level the market runs through fails with the averaging-error notification (RULINGS 132); Fix failed restores it.

level1Amount.description: Level 1's amount, sent as given. The panel form's Auto sends entryAmount × sizeCostMultiplier (MH 630; goodcryptoX's DEX Auto sent the entry's own amount); its Manual row starts there and follows until typed.

level1PricePct.description: Entry to averaging level 1; no multiplier. 0.01 to 99 (§2 row 13). The panel form's Auto sends avgPriceStepPct (C B2, MH 630); its Manual row starts there and follows until typed (MH 628 (a)).

sizeCostMultiplier.description: From level 2, each amount is the previous one times this. 0.01 to 10 (§2 row 14).

priceStepMultiplier.description: From level 3, each gap is the previous gap times this. 0.1 to 10 (§2 row 16).

bracketReduceOnly.description: MH366: TP/SL reduce-only preference copied at bot launch. Absent in old stored settings means true; later preference edits do not modify a running bot.

tpType.description: market: gcx watches the take-profit price and, when the last price reaches it, sends one market order for what the cycle holds; nothing rests on the exchange (goodcryptoX's Stop Market; added 2026-10-08, MH; a build before it reads it as a trailing take-profit of distance 0). limit: rests on the exchange at that price. trailing: starts trailing there and exits when the price falls back by tpTrailingDistancePct. market and limit take the same price.

tpPct.description: From the average entry price (or the entry order's price with tpFixedFromEntry). Above 0 and at most 99 with the take-profit on (§2 row 19; the form's 0 is tpEnabled false).

tpTrailingDistancePct.description: Required for a trailing take-profit; 0.1 to 99, and below tp/(1+tp) for a long, tp/(1-tp) for a short (§2 row 20).

slPct.description: Beyond the last averaging level (the entry with none). Above 0 and at most 99 with the stop-loss on (§2 row 23; the form's 0 is slEnabled false). 10 by the owner's ruling (release plan v4 A20, W21); goodcryptoX's was 15.

slLossPct.description: Added 2026-10-17 (MH 623 (c)-(f)); optional, absent: the stop is `slPct`, as before. The stop as the expected loss: a percent, above 0, of the money the bot uses (spot: the orders' value; perpetual: their margin, the value divided by the leverage; fees and the loss itself are not in it). Each cycle works out its stop for the side it opens and the account's leverage then, rounded so the loss is never more than this and within a tick of it, and keeps it for the cycle; when the loss is reached before the last averaging order, the stop goes inside the ladder and the averaging orders past it are not placed. `slPct` stays required: the distance a build before this one runs on, and what a cycle uses when the leverage could not be read. Only with slEnabled.

repeatOnTp.description: A new cycle after a take-profit, a Close pos. or any close that is not the stop-loss.

cooldownMs.description: The wait between cycles, in milliseconds: the form's menu offers none, 5 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 6 hours and 1 day; any other whole length is a custom one (added 2026-10-17, MH 708; before, only those six were accepted).

closeOnStop.description: Stop closes the position at market.

wholePosition.description: Only this bot trades this pair (was "Only gcx trades this coin"; MH 2026-10-05 line 33, 2026-10-06 rules 321 and 322; decision 0028 d21): a comparison only, never a size. On, a difference between the exchange's position on the coin and the bot's count on two reads gcx can trust waits for the person (red), and something else seen trading the pair (a fill or an order resting at the exchange that is not this bot's) is a notice (yellow); on spot only fewer coins than the bot counts differ. "Exchange is right" then counts every fill on the pair as this bot's. Off: nothing is raised. On only for the single bot on a pair: a bot created beside another that is not done is made with it off, and those with it on turn it off. Changed at once by modify. The take-profit, the stop-loss and every close sell only what the bot bought, on or off. Required on every create; the form starts ticked (unticked on perpetuals with a position open on the coin).

startAt.description: When to start, ms since the epoch.

endAt.description: When to stop, ms since the epoch.

atEnd.description: At the end time: finish the cycle; exit now (close); stop and keep the position.

dca-bot-create.pct99.description: A decimal string from 0 to 99, the old form's top for every percentage (AF:1809-1865); the lower bound of each field is the domain's (validateLiveConfig).

dca-bot-create.decimal.description: A plain unsigned decimal string, never a JSON number.

dca-bot-create.mult10.description: A decimal string from 0 to 10, the old form's top for a multiplier (AF:1825-1840); the lower bound is the domain's.

investment.description: A3 d100: absent means quote. Quote is form metadata. Account is a percent of held account value: Approx. margin on perps (orders margin plus the stop-loss reserve; Grid without a stop reserves to the far band edge, DCA without a stop reserves the loss at the last averaging level plus margin and fees), orders total on spot. Exact resolved sizing is journaled; replay never re-reads.

distance.description: Trailing exit distance in percent. Required and positive for trailing-stop exits.

oneOf.description: Catalogue Q14: bot stops or errors; TP and SL fills; entry and averaging fills from level fromLevel (0 = all).

profitInCoin.description: Spot only: closing orders recover the opening quote and both fees, retaining the profit in coin.

followUp.description: Follow the price up (0040 a1 d34). Absent means off: a grid stored without it never moves. Supported with quote or coin sizing.

followDown.description: Follow the price down (0040 a1 d34). Absent means off. Supported with quote or coin sizing.

useHeld.description: Spot: the start uses the free coins of the pair the account holds and buys only the rest (0040 a1 d33).

upTo.description: The highest price the band moves to; null or absent is no limit (0040 a1 d37).

downTo.description: The lowest price the band moves to; null or absent is no limit (0040 a1 d37).

grid-rule.title: Exact Grid level rule
grid-rule.description: 0040 v3 d4. The typed range becomes one exact linear step or logarithmic ratio at 34 digits. Buttons change only count or i0. Prices are decimal strings; indices and counts are integers. Venue-tick rounding and duplicate merging happen when cells are derived, never when the rule is saved.

stop-rules.properties.countOpenPosition.description: One switch for target, loss, drawdown and neutral. On: realized plus unrealized. Off: realized alone. Changing it resets the drawdown peak to the new quantity, or clears it until that quantity is known.

stop-rules.properties.target.description: Zero is off, as is null. Fire at total greater than or equal to this amount; with stopInNeutral, also require a flat position.

stop-rules.decimal.description: A nonnegative plain decimal string, never a JSON number or exponent.

stop-rules.properties.loss.description: Off by default; zero is off, as is null. Fire at total less than or equal to minus this amount; never delayed by stopInNeutral.

stop-rules.properties.drawdown.description: Zero is off, as is null. Fire when peak minus total reaches this amount. The initial enabled peak is zero; peak notes must be journaled and folded on restart.

stop-rules.properties.stopInNeutral.description: Grid-only use: with a target, wait until both target and zero position hold. Alone, require zero position and nonzero PnL. A neutral stop sends no close.

stop-rules.properties.closeOnStop.description: Honored by stop-above and stop-below. Target, loss and drawdown force a close; a neutral stop has nothing to close.

stop-rules.properties.above.description: Stored stop-above price, already derived from the range. Arms at or below it, then fires at or above it on a subsequent observation; a changed threshold keeps its arm.

stop-rules.properties.below.description: Stored stop-below price. Arms at or above it, then fires at or below it on a subsequent observation; a changed threshold keeps its arm.

stop-rules.properties.activation.description: Zero price is off, as is null. Wait until price reaches the configured side. The activation decision returns this reference price, not the crossing tick's overshoot. Clearing activation while waiting starts at the current price once one is available.

order-command.title: Order command
order-command.description: What the panel and the agent surface send to place an order (POST /api/v1/orders). Every number is a decimal string, never a JSON number. One variant per order type; a field of another type is refused. The runtime dedups on requestId and re-validates with its own tick, balances, position and leverage. Mirrors src/domain/orders/command.ts (OrderCommand). See decisions 0004 §1 and 0007 part 3 decision 4, and docs/reference/orders/validation.md.

sizeUnit.description: base: the base asset; quote: the quote asset (on perps the notional, never the margin). A quote size is converted to base by the engine and floored to the size step; on spot a market buy's at the ask plus the 1 % entry cap, its limit at the exchange, so it never costs more than the amount.

reduceOnly.description: Only reduce the position. On a perpetual an order whose side and size close the position exactly, as gcx reads it when the order arrives, is sent reduce-only without it too, and gets no minimum-order-value warning (since 2026-10-05). On spot, which has no position, it is dropped and the order sent without it (since 2026-10-05; refused before).

delay.description: Timed placement: send after this long.

sendAt.description: Added in E16 (0011 d14): send at this moment; not with delay. The runtime journals it as the delay from its receipt; a moment not ahead of the runtime's clock is refused. Absent (and no delay): sent now.

expected.description: Deprecated (MH 2026-10-05): accepted and ignored. The order goes at the leverage and margin mode the exchange has when it is sent; set them with POST /api/v1/leverage. Until 2026-10-05 an order was refused when this differed from the exchange's.

requestId.description: Caller-minted id (the panel uses a UUID); the runtime makes one order per id.

sourceId.description: The source the order is for: a venue account or a wallet, never the caller

instrumentId.description: The instrument id, e.g. BTC or xyz:SPCX.

type.description: The order type; each variant below fixes it and allows only that type's fields.

overrides.description: Keys of the warnings the user chose to send anyway. Only overridable warnings can be listed; errors cannot be overridden. A trading key's order is sent with its warnings whatever it lists here (RULINGS 75).

order-command.oneTime.description: A moment or a duration, never both (0011 d14).

order-command.millis.description: A duration in milliseconds, as a string.

order-command.instant.description: A moment, in milliseconds since the epoch (UTC), as a string.

order-command.bracket.description: Take-profit targets and one stop-loss attached to the order, placed on its fills. Every combination is valid here, including a limit take-profit with a stop-loss, by hand or from the DCA bot, on perps and on spot (ruling 381 b); on spot gcx's own stop-loss cancels the resting take-profit first and sells once the exchange confirmed the cancel (ruling 296 c).

reduceOnly.description: The take-profit and stop-loss only reduce the position (perpetuals). Default true: absent, the take-profit and stop-loss are reduce-only, whatever Settings › Trading says (MH 520); a received value is honoured. Spot has no reduce-only.

timeInForce.description: Added 2026-10-05 (MH, audit list 24): the take-profit and stop-loss's own time in force, one for both, counted from the order's full fill (on a position, from when they are set); at its end every one still open is cancelled, with one notice. Absent with no cancelAt: one year (31536000000 ms) for new API/MCP submissions, independent of panel Settings (MH481). Old journal rows retain no expiry. An older build ignores it.

cancelAt.description: C79 B2/B4: cancel both TP/SL legs at this UTC moment, not with timeInForce. MH480, MH484 (500 (1)): not before the entry's expiry and (a market or gc-market entry expires at its send; on a position or an order already filled, counted from acceptance): before the entry's expiry is HTTP 400, equality accepted; more than one year after it is the overridable warning trade.bracket.msgExpiryTooLong (HTTP 422 until named in overrides). A late full fill retains this end; the old journal failure path expires elapsed exits without placing. Older readers ignore this field and do not support absolute TP/SL expiry.

order-command.levelMode.description: percent or quoted: a distance from the parent's price; price: an absolute level.

value.description: Percent, quote distance or price, per mode.

dca-bot-create.title: DCA bot settings
dca-bot-create.description: The settings a live DCA bot runs on (decision 0016 §2, §7.2), as the reducer takes them: written by hand to mirror src/domain/dca/live.ts (DcaLiveConfig), kept equal by tests/dca/live-schema.test.ts. Each `default` is goodcryptoX's form default as ruled in 0016 §2 (what a hidden field takes); each range is the old form's. Every money, price and percentage value is a decimal string; counts and times are integers. The account, the instrument, margin and leverage, name and note join this with the create route (slice L2); the TA start's periods and signals came with the signal engine (decision 0017, slice T2). The domain refuses what a pattern cannot (validateLiveConfig): a trailing take-profit that can exit below the average, an amount of zero, the lower bound of each range.

investment.description: A3 d100: absent means quote. Quote is form metadata. Account is a percent of held account value: Approx. margin on perps (ladder margin plus the stop-loss reserve; without a stop, margin and fees plus the loss at the last averaging level), orders total on spot. Exact resolved sizing is journaled; replay never re-reads.

reinvest.description: A2 d70: grow each new cycle by all realized profit, fees and funding included; ignored with account investment

entryCondition.description: When a cycle's entry starts: at once and after each cooldown (manual), on a TA signal (ta; needs taPeriods and taSignals), on a TradingView webhook. POST /api/v1/bots refuses webhook with the named error `entry-condition-not-yet` until the Signal bot ships (release plan v4 §10). goodcryptoX's form defaulted to ta; the panel form opens on Signal too (T3), and this default stays manual: a create that omits the field must not wait on a signal nobody set.

entrySide.description: manual: buy or sell. ta: direct (the signal's side) or inverse. webhook: direct.

taPeriods.description: ta: the candle periods rated, the venue's own (Hyperliquid's fourteen); every one must agree for the bot to start (decision 0017 d8, d9). Required with ta, refused otherwise.

taSignals.description: ta: Detect signals. Buy starts at a rating above 0.1 (a score of 3 of 26), Strong Buy above 0.5 (14 of 26), Sell and Strong Sell the mirror; Buy includes Strong Buy. Required with ta, refused otherwise.

entryDistancePct.description: limit: this far from the market when the entry is made, 0 to 99; trailing: the bounce off the extreme, 0.1 to 99 (§2 row 7).

sizingMode.description: cost: amounts in the quote currency; size: in the base coin.

averaging.description: one: every level a stop-limit triggered at the previous level, one resting at a time (goodcryptoX); all: every level a resting limit at once.

postOnly.description: Averaging limits post-only; a level the market runs through fails with the averaging-error notification (RULINGS 132); Fix failed restores it.

level1Amount.description: Level 1's amount, sent as given. The panel form's Auto sends entryAmount × sizeCostMultiplier (MH 630; goodcryptoX's DEX Auto sent the entry's own amount); its Manual row starts there and follows until typed.

level1PricePct.description: Entry to averaging level 1; no multiplier. 0.01 to 99 (§2 row 13). The panel form's Auto sends avgPriceStepPct (C B2, MH 630); its Manual row starts there and follows until typed (MH 628 (a)).

sizeCostMultiplier.description: From level 2, each amount is the previous one times this. 0.01 to 10 (§2 row 14).

priceStepMultiplier.description: From level 3, each gap is the previous gap times this. 0.1 to 10 (§2 row 16).

bracketReduceOnly.description: MH366: TP/SL reduce-only preference copied at bot launch. Absent in old stored settings means true; later preference edits do not modify a running bot.

tpType.description: market: gcx watches the take-profit price and, when the last price reaches it, sends one market order for what the cycle holds; nothing rests on the exchange (goodcryptoX's Stop Market; added 2026-10-08, MH; a build before it reads it as a trailing take-profit of distance 0). limit: rests on the exchange at that price. trailing: starts trailing there and exits when the price falls back by tpTrailingDistancePct. market and limit take the same price.

tpPct.description: From the average entry price (or the entry order's price with tpFixedFromEntry). Above 0 and at most 99 with the take-profit on (§2 row 19; the form's 0 is tpEnabled false).

tpTrailingDistancePct.description: Required for a trailing take-profit; 0.1 to 99, and below tp/(1+tp) for a long, tp/(1-tp) for a short (§2 row 20).

slPct.description: Beyond the last averaging level (the entry with none). Above 0 and at most 99 with the stop-loss on (§2 row 23; the form's 0 is slEnabled false). 10 by the owner's ruling (release plan v4 A20, W21); goodcryptoX's was 15.

slLossPct.description: Added 2026-10-17 (MH 623 (c)-(f)); optional, absent: the stop is `slPct`, as before. The stop as the expected loss: a percent, above 0, of the money the bot uses (spot: the orders' value; perpetual: their margin, the value divided by the leverage; fees and the loss itself are not in it). Each cycle works out its stop for the side it opens and the account's leverage then, rounded so the loss is never more than this and within a tick of it, and keeps it for the cycle; when the loss is reached before the last averaging order, the stop goes inside the ladder and the averaging orders past it are not placed. `slPct` stays required: the distance a build before this one runs on, and what a cycle uses when the leverage could not be read. Only with slEnabled.

repeatOnTp.description: A new cycle after a take-profit, a Close pos. or any close that is not the stop-loss.

cooldownMs.description: The wait between cycles, in milliseconds: the form's menu offers none, 5 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 6 hours and 1 day; any other whole length is a custom one (added 2026-10-17, MH 708; before, only those six were accepted).

closeOnStop.description: Stop closes the position at market.

wholePosition.description: Only this bot trades this pair (was "Only gcx trades this coin"; MH 2026-10-05 line 33, 2026-10-06 rules 321 and 322; decision 0028 d21): a comparison only, never a size. On, a difference between the exchange's position on the coin and the bot's count on two reads gcx can trust waits for the person (red), and something else seen trading the pair (a fill or an order resting at the exchange that is not this bot's) is a notice (yellow); on spot only fewer coins than the bot counts differ. "Exchange is right" then counts every fill on the pair as this bot's. Off: nothing is raised. On only for the single bot on a pair: a bot created beside another that is not done is made with it off, and those with it on turn it off. Changed at once by modify. The take-profit, the stop-loss and every close sell only what the bot bought, on or off. Required on every create; the form starts ticked (unticked on perpetuals with a position open on the coin).

startAt.description: When to start, ms since the epoch.

endAt.description: When to stop, ms since the epoch.

atEnd.description: At the end time: finish the cycle; exit now (close); stop and keep the position.

dca-bot-create.mult10.description: A decimal string from 0 to 10, the old form's top for a multiplier (AF:1825-1840); the lower bound is the domain's.

distance.description: Trailing exit distance in percent. Required and positive for trailing-stop exits.

oneOf.description: Catalogue Q14: bot stops or errors; TP and SL fills; entry and averaging fills from level fromLevel (0 = all).

profitInCoin.description: Spot only: closing orders recover the opening quote and both fees, retaining the profit in coin.

followUp.description: Follow the price up (0040 a1 d34). Absent means off: a grid stored without it never moves. Supported with quote or coin sizing.

followDown.description: Follow the price down (0040 a1 d34). Absent means off. Supported with quote or coin sizing.

useHeld.description: Spot: the start uses the free coins of the pair the account holds and buys only the rest (0040 a1 d33).

upTo.description: The highest price the band moves to; null or absent is no limit (0040 a1 d37).

downTo.description: The lowest price the band moves to; null or absent is no limit (0040 a1 d37).

grid-rule.title: Exact Grid level rule
grid-rule.description: 0040 v3 d4. The typed range becomes one exact linear step or logarithmic ratio at 34 digits. Buttons change only count or i0. Prices are decimal strings; indices and counts are integers. Venue-tick rounding and duplicate merging happen when cells are derived, never when the rule is saved.

stop-rules.properties.countOpenPosition.description: One switch for target, loss, drawdown and neutral. On: realized plus unrealized. Off: realized alone. Changing it resets the drawdown peak to the new quantity, or clears it until that quantity is known.

stop-rules.properties.target.description: Zero is off, as is null. Fire at total greater than or equal to this amount; with stopInNeutral, also require a flat position.

stop-rules.decimal.description: A nonnegative plain decimal string, never a JSON number or exponent.

stop-rules.properties.loss.description: Off by default; zero is off, as is null. Fire at total less than or equal to minus this amount; never delayed by stopInNeutral.

stop-rules.properties.drawdown.description: Zero is off, as is null. Fire when peak minus total reaches this amount. The initial enabled peak is zero; peak notes must be journaled and folded on restart.

stop-rules.properties.stopInNeutral.description: Grid-only use: with a target, wait until both target and zero position hold. Alone, require zero position and nonzero PnL. A neutral stop sends no close.

stop-rules.properties.closeOnStop.description: Honored by stop-above and stop-below. Target, loss and drawdown force a close; a neutral stop has nothing to close.

stop-rules.properties.above.description: Stored stop-above price, already derived from the range. Arms at or below it, then fires at or above it on a subsequent observation; a changed threshold keeps its arm.

stop-rules.properties.below.description: Stored stop-below price. Arms at or above it, then fires at or below it on a subsequent observation; a changed threshold keeps its arm.

stop-rules.properties.activation.description: Zero price is off, as is null. Wait until price reaches the configured side. The activation decision returns this reference price, not the crossing tick's overshoot. Clearing activation while waiting starts at the current price once one is available.
