tiers.description: Added by 0030 amendment 1 TR1b: the tiers POST /api/v1/updates/tier installs, those at or below the install's ceiling (install.json updates.ceiling, the highest tier it ever ran), highest first. Settings › For developers shows Updates from where it holds more than one. Served where goodcryptoX swaps its own program (the Mac's and the Windows helper, the Linux desktop) and in Docker (the compose line); absent elsewhere, on a development build and on an older runtime.

stop-rules.decimal.description: A nonnegative plain decimal string, never a JSON number or exponent.

stop-rules.properties.above.description: Stored stop-above price, already derived from the range. Arms at or below it, then fires at or above it on a subsequent observation; a changed threshold keeps its arm.

stop-rules.properties.activation.description: Zero price is off, as is null. Wait until price reaches the configured side. The activation decision returns this reference price, not the crossing tick's overshoot. Clearing activation while waiting starts at the current price once one is available.

stop-rules.properties.below.description: Stored stop-below price. Arms at or above it, then fires at or below it on a subsequent observation; a changed threshold keeps its arm.

stop-rules.properties.closeOnStop.description: Honored by stop-above and stop-below. Target, loss and drawdown force a close; a neutral stop has nothing to close.

stop-rules.properties.countOpenPosition.description: One switch for target, loss, drawdown and neutral. On: realized plus unrealized. Off: realized alone. Changing it resets the drawdown peak to the new quantity, or clears it until that quantity is known.

stop-rules.properties.drawdown.description: Zero is off, as is null. Fire when peak minus total reaches this amount. The initial enabled peak is zero; peak notes must be journaled and folded on restart.

stop-rules.properties.loss.description: Off by default; zero is off, as is null. Fire at total less than or equal to minus this amount; never delayed by stopInNeutral.

stop-rules.properties.stopInNeutral.description: Grid-only use: with a target, wait until both target and zero position hold. Alone, require zero position and nonzero PnL. A neutral stop sends no close.

stop-rules.properties.target.description: Zero is off, as is null. Fire at total greater than or equal to this amount; with stopInNeutral, also require a flat position.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: GET /api/v1/runtime/storage (decision 0031 d13 to d16): how much disk the data folder takes, by part, and the history (the database) by account and by month. The folder's parts are counted on each request; the history's figures are an estimate, counted in the background while the page asks (`?count=0` asks for the folder alone and starts no count): each is its share of the journal's rows × the database's used pages, so they add up. Byte counts are whole numbers. Additions to /api/v1.

state.description: `counting` until the first count reaches the end of the journal; `ready` after (the figures then follow the journal with each request).

at.description: When the count last reached the end of the journal (ms since the epoch); null before the first.

parts.description: In this order: history (the database and its log), logs, updates (downloads), backups (before updates), reserve (kept free for a full disk), other (keys, settings).

accounts.description: The history by account, in the order the accounts were added. An account removed with its trading history deleted is not listed; its rows are in `shared` until erased.

removed.description: Being removed, or removed with its history kept.

groups.description: The parts of `bytes`: orders and trades, bots, funding, and the account's own records.

shared.description: No account's: prices gcx acted on and gcx's own records.

months.description: The history by month of the row's own time (UTC): the last twelve, oldest first, then `earlier`.

free.description: Free inside the database: reused by new history, the file does not shrink.

compacted.description: Each deletion of an account's data, from its marker in the journal: when, how many rows, and the accounts' ids (no name, no address).

trafficSince.description: Added by 0020 amendment 1: the start (ms, a UTC hour) of the oldest hour the exchange traffic log (`wire/`) still holds, null when it holds none. Less than 7 days back when the Logs size set in Settings › Storage is reached first.
